name: drone_next_action
input_text: Photo from the patrol drone at its current bay stop, plus the patrol state as JSON. This is advisory: a code safety supervisor validates every action against geofence, battery and people-distance limits before the flight loop executes it.
instructions: What should the patrol do next after this bay stop?

choices.description: This bay was inspected clearly and no follow-up is needed; continue to the next planned bay.
The bay is too far, small or partly out of frame to judge; approach within the standoff limit.
The image is blurred, dark or obstructed; hold and capture again.
An issue is visible and clear enough to report; flag it and continue the patrol.
Patrol is complete, battery is near its minimum, or the mission was stopped; return to home.
A person is close to the drone, the view shows an unsafe situation, or the state is inconsistent; abort and land safely.
